metadata.description: Unique name for the customization.
Artifact blob path relative to the configured container, or a full HTTP or HTTPS URI.
Optional arguments passed to the customization artifact.
Optional. Override download URL for the AVD Agent Boot Loader installer. Leave empty to use the default Microsoft-hosted URL for the current cloud.
Optional. Override download URL for the AVD Agent installer. Leave empty to use the default Microsoft-hosted URL for the current cloud.
Optional. URI of the blob storage container holding scripts and artifacts for session host customizations.
Optional. Resource ID of the user-assigned managed identity with Storage Blob Data Reader access to the artifacts container.
Optional. VM availability strategy.
Optional. Naming convention for availability sets. Use ## token for the index (e.g., "avset-01"). Defaults to "avset-##".
Optional. Availability zones to spread session hosts across when availability is AvailabilityZones.
Optional. Resource ID of the AVD Insights data collection rule.
Optional. When true, enables OS disk encryption with VMGuestState for confidential VMs.
Required. Resource ID of the Key Vault containing VirtualMachineAdminPassword, VirtualMachineAdminUserName, DomainJoinUserPassword, and DomainJoinUserPrincipalName secrets.
Optional. Resource ID of the Azure Monitor data collection endpoint.
Optional. Per-VM array of dedicated host group resource IDs. One entry per session host, a single-entry array applied to all, or empty for no assignment.
Optional. Per-VM array of dedicated host resource IDs. One entry per session host, a single-entry array applied to all, or empty for no assignment.
Optional. Per-VM preferred availability zones (as zone strings). One entry per session host, or empty for no preference.
Optional. Resource ID of the disk access resource to restrict managed disk network access.
Optional. Resource ID of the disk encryption set for customer-managed key encryption.
Optional. OS disk size in GB. 0 inherits the image default.
Optional. Storage SKU for the OS disk.
Optional. Active Directory domain name for domain join. Leave empty for Entra ID join.
Optional. Enable accelerated networking on session host NICs.
Optional. Enable IPv6 on session host NICs.
Optional. Enable Azure Monitor on session hosts.
Optional. Enable encryption at host for all disks and cache.
Optional. Configure FSLogix profile container settings on session hosts.
Optional. FSLogix container type.
Optional. Resource IDs of local Azure NetApp Files volumes for FSLogix. Provide one ID for Profile Container, or two IDs for Profile and Office Containers in profile-then-office order.
Optional. Resource IDs of local storage accounts for FSLogix.
Optional. Entra ID group object IDs for FSLogix Office container separation.

Optional. Resource IDs of remote Azure NetApp Files volumes for FSLogix cloud cache failover. Provide none, one ID for Profile Container, or two IDs for Profile and Office Containers in profile-then-office order.
Optional. Resource IDs of remote storage accounts for FSLogix cloud cache failover.
Optional. Maximum size of FSLogix VHD/VHDX in megabytes.
Optional. Storage service backing FSLogix containers.
Optional. Enable VM hibernation on session hosts.
Required. Resource ID of the AVD host pool that session hosts will be registered with.
Required. Identity join method for session hosts.
Required. Image reference for session host VMs. Use {"publisher":"...","offer":"...","sku":"..."} for marketplace images or {"id":"..."} for Compute Gallery images.
Optional. License type applied to VMs when imageReference uses a custom/gallery image ("id"). Ignored for marketplace images.
Optional. Enable Guest Attestation extension for boot integrity monitoring.
Optional. Enroll session hosts in Microsoft Intune.
Optional. Azure region for session host VMs.
Optional. Naming convention for NICs. SHNAME is replaced with the session host name at deploy time. Defaults to "nic-SHNAME".
Optional. Naming convention for OS disks. SHNAME is replaced with the session host name at deploy time. Defaults to "disk-SHNAME".
Optional. OU path in Active Directory for session host computer accounts.
Optional. Enable Secure Boot on session host VMs.
Optional. VM security profile type.
Optional. Custom script extension configurations for post-provisioning session host customization.
Optional. Number of digits in the zero-padded VM index (used for both naming modes).
Optional. Explicit array of session host computer names (e.g. ["avd01","avd02"]). When non-empty, takes precedence over convention mode. Used by the Session Host Replacer.
Optional. Short prefix for session host computer names in convention mode (e.g. "avd"). Ignored when sessionHostNames is non-empty.
Optional. Number of session hosts to deploy in convention mode. Ignored when sessionHostNames is non-empty.
Optional. Starting index for VM name generation in convention mode. Ignored when sessionHostNames is non-empty.
Required. Resource ID of the subnet where session host NICs will be placed.
Optional. Tags applied to all deployed resources, keyed by resource type.
Optional. Windows time zone for session host VMs.
Optional. Naming convention for VM names. SHNAME is replaced with the session host name at deploy time. Defaults to "vm-SHNAME".
Required. Azure VM size for session hosts.
Optional. Enable virtual TPM on session host VMs.

Optional. Resource ID of an existing Recovery Services Vault to register session host VMs with for backup. When provided, VMs will be enrolled in the backup policy specified by vmBackupPolicyName. Intended for personal host pools.
Optional. Name of the backup policy within the Recovery Services Vault to apply to session host VMs. Defaults to the standard AVD VM policy name when empty.
Unique name for the customization.
Artifact blob path relative to the configured container, or a full HTTP or HTTPS URI.
Optional arguments passed to the customization artifact.
Optional. License type applied to VMs deployed from a custom/gallery image. Ignored for marketplace images.
